# Original catalog fixtures

These synthetic .example entries and metadata were authored for DRouteX and use
the repository Apache-2.0 license. They are not downloaded feed data or production
license approvals. The golden resource was independently assembled with Python
stdlib json/hashlib from domains.txt, explicit metadata/mode and canonical names;
its source and resource hashes are different quantities. service-v1.json pins the
actual golden resource SHA-256. No proprietary list or network source is included.
